import json,os,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path("/home/zech/Projects/.build-worktrees/workspaces/proj-1/task-894-laz-9c889632-34a8-47b8-881f-8ed0a0a57e3c/Build");s=Path('/home/zech/Projects/.agent-scratch/894')
head='b38e11bc78fd0b6925352425e54b931a249101ba'
out=s/'review3-final-backend';out.mkdir()
os.environ['CARGO_BUILD_JOBS']='8';os.environ['TMPDIR']=str(s)
groups=[(name,['cargo','test','--lib',filt,'--','--nocapture','--test-threads=1']) for name,filt in [
 ('tree-pages','app::fs::tree_pages::'),('filesystem','app::tests::filesystem::'),('sql-reads','app::tests::runtime::sql_reads::'),('file-hints','changes::subscriptions::files_hints_')]]
groups += [('format',['cargo','fmt','--check']),('clippy',['cargo','clippy','--all-targets','--','-D','warnings'])]
def record(v):
 with (out/'commands.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps(v)+'\n');f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
rows=[]
for label,args in groups:
 h=subprocess.run(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,check=False)
 record({'event':'head','argv':['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],'cwd':str(root),'exit_code':h.returncode,'head':h.stdout.strip()})
 if h.returncode or h.stdout.strip()!=head:raise RuntimeError('source head changed')
 argv=['nice','-n','10',*args];record({'event':'start','label':label,'argv':argv,'cwd':str(root/'bridge'),'head':head})
 with (out/(label+'.log')).open('wb') as f:r=subprocess.run(argv,cwd=root/'bridge',stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=False)
 record({'event':'complete','label':label,'argv':argv,'cwd':str(root/'bridge'),'exit_code':r.returncode,'head':head})
 rows.append({'label':label,'exit_code':r.returncode})
 if r.returncode:break
code=0 if len(rows)==len(groups) and all(x['exit_code']==0 for x in rows) else 1
